cases.note: spelled to ursus's documented rule (step 507): Round rounds to the nearer month, halfway up, so noon on the 15th of a 29-day February is March; Polars' round adds fourteen days and truncates, so it is asked as the nearer of truncate and a month after it

cases.name: round_1mo_dates

cases.name: midnight_gap_windows
cases.note: spelled to ursus's documented rule (step 507): a dynamic group's day starts on truncate's grid, at 01:00 where Santiago's midnight is missing; Polars' group_by_dynamic starts it at 23:00 on the 7th, a day off its own truncate, so it is asked as a group-by of truncate('1d'), no window empty here; the count cast to Int64 on both sides, a Uint64 here and a UInt32 there
